review_type: independent AI review in a separate review session
scope: Standalone English and Korean readings, then full bilingual metadata/body/table/fence comparison; static code semantics and linked official source checks.
audience: Developers choosing an open-source engine without a specified genre/team; concise document-based comparison plus headless Godot movement probe.

standalone_assessment.en: Core conditional answer appears immediately. Release table, workflow comparisons, licensing/platform exceptions and limited Godot probe form a coherent document-based comparison. No material prose ambiguity identified.
standalone_assessment.ko: Core conditional answer appears immediately. Korean prose preserves practical selection conditions and cleanly limits the movement check; no material clarity issue identified.

bilingual_assessment: Entire two 142-line articles compared. Titles/descriptions are localized within matching scope. Dates, releases, source links, table conditions, runtime assumptions, actual-output wording and limitations align. All four fenced blocks are byte-for-byte identical between languages (ini, gdscript, sh, text). Diagram alt text is localized and describes the same single-call operation.
static_code_assessment: Eight table cases and one split-time equivalence check match the printed count nine. limit_length caps magnitude without normalizing smaller input; speed/time application and point clamp match prose. Finite-input/nonnegative-time assumptions and absent physics/render/export coverage are explicit. No engine execution was performed in this review.

verification_limits: This review did not execute Godot or independently substantiate the author execution statement; parent must retain actual execution evidence.

conclusion: No unresolved material text, bilingual-parity or checked-source contradiction found within reviewed scope. Publication still depends on actual execution and generated-diagram/build checks outside this review.
confidence: high for bilingual parity and checked factual claims; static-only for executable behavior
